what: The sections of this article, each with a line and a paragraph, for showing what the reader has already read. Built by admin/build/summaries.py from admin/content/articles/summaries/.

sections.label: The opening
sections.line: Job-seeker and virtual-professional websites that show evidence, built by an agentic cell, with personas and a brief.
sections.para: Seven pages, a page per employer, a recruiter pack, a ladder.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: CVs trusted less; seven pages; a page for you; recruiters; make it yours; agent team; virtual pros; personas and brief.

sections.label: Why now
sections.line: AI-generated applications make skills harder to verify, so proof beats a better list.

sections.label: Seven pages that prove
sections.line: Home, evidence, thinking, me, a page for you, working with me, recruiter pack, plus machine files.
sections.para: Privacy and consistency rules on every page.

sections.label: Eight people looking for a job
sections.line: Eight synthetic people, from a developer to a graduate, each with a different site.

sections.label: Make it yours
sections.line: Each site should look like its owner, not like every other AI site.
sections.para: The person geeks out and makes it theirs.

sections.label: A page for you
sections.line: An unlisted, expiring page per application or meeting, with something made for that employer.
sections.para: Public material only; anonymised when public.

sections.label: For recruiters
sections.line: A one-screen pack on every site, and a recruiter's cell with shortlists from candidates' own pages.

sections.label: Virtual professionals
sections.line: vCISO, vCTO, vDPO, designer and editor personas who sell their judgement and the agent team behind it.
sections.para: An agent-team block, an engagement pack, a cell per client.

sections.label: The pipeline and the team
sections.line: Interview, evidence, draft, make it yours, tailor, check, publish, by a team of six agent roles.
sections.para: QA blocks invented facts; the person approves and sends.

sections.label: From a recipe to a recruiter's cell
sections.line: A free recipe, a free fork, then £500, £1,500, £5,000 and a recruiter's cell at £20,000.

sections.label: For us first
sections.line: A version for me, and for team members who want one, reviewed by them first.
sections.para: The mock-ups are the references our sites lacked.

sections.label: The brief for the team
sections.line: Fourteen tasks: template, themes, interview, evidence, design, tailoring, QA, recruiters, tests, virtual pros, hub.
sections.para: Build from the mock-ups and cross-check.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Invented personas (thirteen); designs not a product; thin evidence for sites; first-proposal prices.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: Robert Half, Greenhouse, JSON Resume, llms.txt reports, admired personal sites, earlier articles.
